description: The chart represents the distribution of different stimuli types, showing the proportion of each category. The chart is divided into eight slices, each representing a distinct stimuli type. The slices are labeled with their corresponding categories and percentages. The categories and their approximate percentages are: Press Release (21.9%, yellow), External News Article (13.1%, green), Interview (10.2%, dark blue), Event Posting (8.8%, light purple), Organizational Report (8.8%, red), Organizational Website (6.6%, light blue), Social Media Post (1.5%, light green), and Intra-agency news article (0.7%, orange). The chart includes percentage labels outside the slices, and the slices are arranged in a doughnut chart format with the labels placed around the outer edge. The chart does not include a legend, and the slices are not visually emphasized or ordered in a particular way.
